name: tabpfn
description: Connect to the TabPFN API for tabular prediction tasks including classification, regression, and feature analysis
long_description: TabPFN is a foundation model for tabular data. This bundle connects to the TabPFN MCP server, giving you access to tools for classification, regression, and data analysis on tabular datasets — all powered by Prior Labs' hosted API.
